security.csp: default-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' asset: data:; connect-src ipc: http://ipc.localhost

bundle.shortDescription: A local-only desktop app for writing, organizing, and linking Markdown notes.
bundle.longDescription: Obsidian At Home stores Markdown notes on your device. Organize them in folders, connect them with wiki links and backlinks, search locally, use templates and CSS snippets, and import or export Obsidian vaults.
